home.subtitle: ESG Data Management & Reporting Platform
home.welcomeTitle: Welcome to the Triple I ESG Portal
home.welcomeBody: Start by uploading workforce data (S1) or emissions data (E1) using the modules below. Our AI will automatically clean and structure your data, no matter the format or language. Click the chat bubble in the bottom-right corner anytime to ask your AI assistant for help.
home.pickIndustry: Pick your industry to unlock sector-specific KPIs
home.pickIndustryDesc: Each pack adds the right materiality starters, emission factors, and disclosure templates for your sector. You can change this later in Settings.
home.creditsTooltip: Credits are consumed when you process data. Excel uploads cost 1 credit per row. Document extractions cost 2 credits per document. Your balance is shown here.
home.activeModulesTooltip: Currently E1 (Climate Change) and S1 (Own Workforce) are active. Other modules are coming soon or available with Enterprise.

dashboard.e1Subtitle: GHG emissions, carbon footprint analysis, and SBTi targets
dashboard.s1Subtitle: Workforce composition, diversity, training, and workplace safety

reports.title: ESG Report Generation
reports.subtitle: Generate standard-compliant sustainability reports from your connected data
reports.exportFormatInfo: Choose whether to download the report as a PDF or editable Word document (.docx).
reports.pdfDesc: Print-ready report with charts and visualisations (.pdf)
reports.wordDesc: Editable Microsoft Word file you can customise (.docx)
reports.checkDownloads: Check your downloads folder for the {format}.
reports.compilingDisclosures: Compiling disclosures, formatting metrics, generating narrative sections, and assembling the final document...

settings.title: Settings
settings.standardsDesc: The reporting framework used for compliance reports
settings.sectorPackDesc: Which industry pack (KPIs, materiality starters, factors) is active
settings.dataResetDesc: Permanently delete uploaded data by year
settings.creditTransactionsDesc: View credit usage history and remaining balance
settings.selectStandard: Select the reporting standard for your ESG disclosures.
settings.logoFormat: PNG, JPG, or WebP. Max 5MB. Recommended: square, at least 200x200px.
settings.logoUsage: The logo will be displayed on the first page of all generated reports.
settings.sectorPackBody: Each pack adds sector-specific KPIs, materiality starters, and emission factors to your dashboards and reports. Existing data is preserved when switching.
settings.benchmarkBody: Share anonymised KPI values to unlock peer benchmarks. Your data is never linked to your company name and only aggregated statistics (p25 / p50 / p75) are ever shown to anyone — never raw values. Cohorts with fewer than 10 companies are hidden entirely (k-anonymity). You can withdraw at any time; withdrawal is retroactive.
settings.optedInDesc: Your aggregated data counts toward sector benchmarks and you can see percentile rankings on dashboards.
settings.notOptedInDesc: You can contribute and see peer benchmarks once you opt in.
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change this setting.
settings.resetWarning: Data reset is permanent and cannot be undone. Preview the data below before deleting.
settings.typeYearToConfirm: This action cannot be undone. Type the year below to confirm:

pcf.title: Product Carbon Footprints
pcf.subtitle: Manage products and their lifecycle carbon footprints
pcf.howItWorksBody: Create a product, upload its Bill of Materials (BOM) spreadsheet, and our AI will classify materials and match emission factors automatically. Then run a calculation to get the product's carbon footprint with uncertainty ranges.
pcf.noProductsDesc: Create your first product to start calculating its carbon footprint.
pcf.anyColumnOrder: Any column order, any language. 2 credits.
pcf.describeProduct: Describe the product — AI builds the BOM for you
pcf.industryProportions: Uses industry-standard proportions. 2 credits. Review before use.
pcf.noBomData: No BOM data yet. Upload a spreadsheet above to get started.
pcf.recycledDesc: Swap primary metals for their recycled equivalents.
pcf.renewableDesc: Swap every region's grid electricity to EU-mix as a proxy for PPA-backed supply.
pcf.relocationDesc: Swap every grid electricity factor to VN.
pcf.generateBomDesc: Describe your product and the AI will propose a realistic BOM with material classes, typical quantities, and confidence scores. You can edit every row after generation.
pcf.aiGeneratedWarning: AI-generated, never primary data. The proposed BOM uses industry-average proportions and assumptions, not your actual suppliers' reported data. Review each row and replace with primary data when you have it — this directly affects your ESRS E1 §51(g) primary-data share.

roi.title: Sustainability ROI Module
roi.subtitle: Let the platform prove the business case for sustainability.
roi.platformTranslates: The platform translates your emissions, energy, and workforce data into USD impact — without any manual spreadsheets.
roi.howRoiBody: Each pillar compares a baseline year against the current year using the data you've already uploaded, then multiplies the delta by a financial assumption (electricity price, carbon tax, recruiting cost, revenue share) to surface USD impact. Update the assumptions any time from the financial data link above — the dashboard recalculates instantly.
roi.energySavingsDesc: Auto-calculate ROI from energy efficiency initiatives vs. baseline spend. Show CFO the payback period.
roi.carbonTaxDesc: Model avoided carbon tax liability as emissions reduce. Translate tCO2e into USD saved.
roi.contractDesc: Quantify revenue at risk or unlocked by ESG certification. Show which OEM contracts require it.
roi.hrTalentDesc: Link social diversity and wellbeing scores to recruitment cost reductions and retention data.
roi.noEsgDataDesc: Upload some emissions or workforce data first. As soon as we have one or more reporting years on file, the ROI module will start translating it into USD impact.
roi.financialDataDesc: These assumptions drive the ROI calculations. Update them when your CFO provides current prices or targets.
roi.esgRevenueShare: Share of revenue tied to ESG-certified contracts (%)

suppliers.title: Supplier Scope 3 Portal
suppliers.subtitle: Collect primary emissions data directly from your supply chain
suppliers.howItWorksBody: Add your suppliers, send them a data request, and they submit their emissions data through a simple branded form — no account needed. Once you approve a submission, it flows into your Scope 3 inventory as primary data, boosting your ESRS primary-data coverage.

auth.businessEmailOnly: Please use a business email address. Personal emails (Gmail, Hotmail, Yahoo, etc.) are not accepted.

sectorKpis.narrativeDesc: This is a narrative disclosure — it requires a written description rather than a number. You can draft this text in the Reports module when generating your sustainability report.
sectorKpis.notReportedDesc: Not yet reported — this metric doesn't have data in the system yet. Upload the relevant data through the appropriate module, or enter it manually in your next reporting cycle.
